reason: Restore the ioctl ABI enabled in the extracted OS4.0.6 stock kernel; separate /dev/ashmem support does not handle ioctls on memfd descriptors. Not a claim this caused a prior boot failure.
upstream_context: ACK later removed this shim from older-kernel branches (e.g. aba16327dea522cc30a043a71bb604e5f0e2dc84 says only needed for 6.12+). This is an annibale stock-ABI parity choice, not a general 6.6 requirement.
